title: exactIMM: Fast Optimal Filtering in Gaussian Switching Systems
description:
Reference implementation of the AB-constrained Gaussian Switching System (GSS) framework: a fast constant-gain exact optimal filter under the AB structural assumption, with support for a known exogenous input (deterministic command), supervised and semi-supervised parameter estimation (Baum-Welch EM), and Monte-Carlo benchmarks including real-data studies (vehicle dynamics and NOAA ENSO indices).

The repository also contains the reference implementations (exact K^N mixture filter, order-1 IMM, GPB2) and the experiment script backing the numerical section of the companion paper on the exactness domains of the IMM and GPB2 filters.
